label: Data Resource
definition: An owl:Thing to which a data quality bdqffdq:Response applies.

label: applies To
definition: Describes the bdqffdq:DataResource about which a bdqffdq:Response is made.
notes: If a bdqffdq:Response forms the oa:hasBody of an oa:Annotation, the bdqffdq:appliesTo bdqffdq:DataResource would be the oa:hasTarget of the oa:Annotation. If bdqffdq:Responses are composed in bdqffdq:DataQualityReports, the bdqffdq:appliesTo bdqffdq:DataResource is an item examined as part of the bdqffdq:DataQualityReport. Expectation for bdqffdq:SingleRecord Test bdqffdq:Responses on Darwin Core data in the BDQ standard is that bdqffdq:appliesTo would point at a dwc:Occurrence record.
